statBlock.name: Grung Elite Warrior
statBlock.description: Elite warriors command members of the lower castes. Volo gives this profile to orange warriors and gold leaders.

sections.Traits:
Amphibious. The grung breathes air and water.
Poisonous Skin. A creature that grapples the grung or makes direct contact with its skin must pass a DC 12 Constitution save or be poisoned for 1 minute. Once direct contact ends, the poisoned creature can repeat the save at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.
Standing Leap. The grung can long jump up to 25 ft. and high jump up to 15 ft. with or without a running start.
Water Dependency. A grung that spends less than 1 hour immersed in water during a day gains one level of exhaustion at the end of that day. Magic or at least 1 hour of immersion can remove exhaustion gained this way.
sections.Actions:
Dagger. Melee or ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, reach 5 ft. or range 20/60 ft., one target. A hit deals 5 (1d4 + 3) piercing damage. The target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution save.
Shortbow. Ranged weapon attack, +5 to hit, range 80/320 ft., one target. A hit deals 6 (1d6 + 3) piercing damage. The target also takes 5 (2d4) poison damage if it fails a DC 12 Constitution save.
Mesmerizing Chirr (Recharge 6). Each Humanoid or Beast within 15 ft. that can hear the chirr must pass a DC 12 Wisdom save or be stunned until the end of the grung's next turn. Grungs are immune to the chirr.
sections.Optional Grung poison mechanics:
Use the weapon’s listed Constitution save for its extra poison damage. The color effect follows the poisoned condition from this grung.
The poison loses its potency 1 minute after removal from the grung. Its poison also loses potency 1 minute after it dies.
Choose the effect that matches the grung's color. It lasts as long as the target remains poisoned by this grung.
Green. The target can move only by climbing or making standing jumps. If it is flying, it cannot take actions or reactions until it lands.
Blue. The target must shout or make another loud noise at both the start and the end of each turn.
Purple. The target must seek liquid or mud to soak in. It can move and take actions only to reach it or soak in it.
Red. If food is within reach, the target must spend its action eating.
Orange. The target is frightened of its allies.
Gold. The target is charmed by the grung and can speak Grung.
sections.Printed source: Volo's Guide to Monsters, pp. 156–157. Stat block on p. 157.
